result_source: clickhouse-client scalar result and system.query_log QueryFinish
sql:
SELECT count(*) FROM lakehouse.`silver.payment_events` AS attempt
JOIN lakehouse.`silver.payment_events` AS created
  ON created.integration_id = attempt.integration_id AND created.payment_id = attempt.payment_id
WHERE attempt.payload_case = 'attempt_started' AND created.payload_case = 'payment_created'
  AND (attempt.attempt_started.context.snapshot.total.minor_units
      <> created.payment_created.snapshot.total.minor_units
    OR attempt.attempt_started.context.snapshot.total.currency
      <> created.payment_created.snapshot.total.currency)
SETTINGS iceberg_snapshot_id = 8514390407709950043, max_bytes_before_external_group_by = 800000000, max_bytes_before_external_sort = 400000000, join_algorithm = 'full_sorting_merge', max_threads = 2, max_block_size = 16384
